info.name: Sitecore CDP REST Audit Orders API

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

items.docs: Retrieves all orders associated with a guest profile. Returns order summaries including order references, totals, status, and creation dates.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

items.docs: Creates a new order record associated with a guest profile. Orders capture purchase transactions and support segmentation and personalization based on purchasing behavior. The referenceId and orderedAt fields are immutable after creation.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: orderRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the order

items.docs: Retrieves a specific order by its reference identifier. Returns the full order object including all line items, contacts, and data extensions.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: orderRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the order

items.docs: Performs a full replacement update of an order record. Note that the referenceId and orderedAt fields cannot be changed after the order has been created.

params.name: guestRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the guest profile

params.name: orderRef
params.description: The unique reference identifier for the order

items.docs: Permanently deletes an order record and all associated items, contacts, consumers, and data extensions. This operation is irreversible.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: search
params.description: Full-text search term to filter results

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page (max 100)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve (1-indexed)

params.name: buyerID
params.description: Filter orders by buyer identifier

params.name: status
params.description: Filter orders by status

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of orders in the specified direction context. Use 'Incoming' for orders received by the seller and 'Outgoing' for orders placed by a buyer. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

items.docs: Creates a new order in the specified direction context. New orders begin in the Unsubmitted status. Line items, promotions, and payments can be added before the order is submitted.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: orderID
params.description: The unique identifier of the order

items.docs: Retrieves a specific order by its identifier and direction. Returns the full order object including status, totals, shipping address, and billing address.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: orderID
params.description: The unique identifier of the order

items.docs: Performs a full replacement update of an order. Only orders in Unsubmitted status can be updated. Submitted orders cannot be modified.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: orderID
params.description: The unique identifier of the order

items.docs: Permanently deletes an order. Only unsubmitted orders can be deleted.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: orderID
params.description: The unique identifier of the order

items.docs: Submits an order for fulfillment. The order must be in Unsubmitted status and have all required line items, payment methods, and addresses set before submission. Submitted orders transition to Open or AwaitingApproval status.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: orderID
params.description: The unique identifier of the order

items.docs: Retrieves all line items within a specific order. Each line item represents a product or variant being purchased with a specified quantity and pricing.

params.name: direction
params.description: The order direction context - Incoming (seller view) or Outgoing (buyer view)

params.name: orderID
params.description: The unique identifier of the order

items.docs: Adds a line item to an order specifying a product and quantity. Specs and spec option values can be provided to select a specific product variant.
